transcript.text: Hi, good evening! This is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking with Mr. Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul speaking. Good evening! How can I help you today?
Thank you. I'm an automated assistant, and this call is recorded. Is your Mumbai Bank card the one ending in four, two, seven, one?
Yes, that's the right card number ending in 4271.
Got it, thanks. It looks like this month's payment hasn't come through yet. Is all well?
Oh, I see. I'm sorry about that, I completely forgot to make the payment this month. It won't happen again.
I see. Would it help if I sent you a secure payment link by SMS right now? It'll just take a minute. When would suit you to pay?
Thank you, I appreciate that. I can pay the full minimum due by the 4th of next month. Would that work?
Alright, thanks for letting me know. So, you'll pay 4,820 rupees by 4th November. Does that sound right?
Yes, that's correct. I will pay 4,820 rupees by the 4th of November.
